segmentation.text: shall at any time be driven
through or within a safety zone.

elements.justification: 'vehicle' is a defined term whose admitted aggregate is DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; claimed as the aggregate. Same mapping as the index's 'No vehicle'.

'be driven' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion: a vehicle moving on the road is taken to be driven. Moving is the negation of drv.motion.complete_halt ('at rest at the observation ... its speed (kin.speed) at or below a tolerance'). 'at any time' makes every observation a judged one.

'safety zone' (DEF-NRS-484B-057: 'the area officially set aside within a highway for the exclusive use of pedestrians and which is so plainly marked') is st.safety_zone, 'an area within the highway marked off for pedestrians only'; 'through or within' it is the vehicle's footprint overlapping it (rel.occupies: 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region (..., safety zone, ...)').

applicability: The subject is a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) that is moving at the observation: not drv.motion.complete_halt(subject) with speed_tol = p.halt_speed_tolerance.
obligation: At every such observation the subject's footprint overlaps no safety zone: for every region z of kind st.safety_zone, not rel.occupies(subject, z).

narrowings.why: 'be driven' is read through the vehicle's motion: a moving vehicle is taken to be driven, whoever or whatever controls it.
A safety zone 'officially set aside' and 'plainly marked' is read by the presence of the marked st.safety_zone region.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A car moving at 8 m/s crosses a marked safety zone: its footprint overlaps the zone at several observations.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: A car moving at 8 m/s passes beside the safety zone, its footprint never overlapping it.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A car stays at rest at the curb for the whole recording.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: A car moves past a safety zone; the source does not report which regions the car's footprint overlaps.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: proposed this iteration by LVMC_11_12_070_B; speed resolution of the acquisition standard
